title: editoxml action
description: Converts a delimited EDI body into XML: <edi-message> with a <delimiters> element and an element per segment, named after its first field, holding <field.N>, <component.N> and <sub-component.N>.

segment.title: Segment delimiter
segment.description: Ends a segment; LB is a line break

field.title: Field delimiter
field.description: Separates the fields of a segment

component.title: Component delimiter
component.description: Separates the components of a field

subComponent.title: Sub-component delimiter
subComponent.description: Separates the sub-components of a component
